meaning_en: operating and working properly
quote: The website's up and running
quote_cn: 网站已经上线了。
example: The new billing service has been up and running since Tuesday.
example_cn: 新的计费服务周二就上线了。
note: 科技/职场高频。get something up and running＝把它跑起来。

meaning_en: to disturb an established industry from outside it
meaning_cn: 颠覆；用新方式冲击传统行业
quote: we're disrupting digital media
quote_cn: 我们在颠覆数字媒体。
example: Startups are disrupting the whole payments sector.
example_cn: 初创公司正在颠覆整个支付行业。
note: 源自 disruption theory（以新技术取代旧产业）。名词 disruption。

meaning_en: to present an idea to persuade someone to back it
quote: when you pitched me Pied Piper you said it was gonna be
quote_cn: 你当时向我推介 Pied Piper 的时候说……
example: She pitched the idea to three investors in one afternoon.
example_cn: 她一下午把这个想法推介给了三位投资人。
note: 名词 a pitch＝推介；也可指球场传球或音高。

meaning_en: the point at which something takes off
quote: once it reaches a critical mass of users
quote_cn: 一旦用户量达到临界规模
example: The product stalled until it hit critical mass.
example_cn: 这个产品一直不温不火，直到达到临界规模。
note: 借自物理学；平台经济常用，指用户/节点足够多后自我加速。

meaning_en: to violate a law or right, such as a copyright
quote: if you're infringing on any copyrighted material
quote_cn: 如果你侵犯了任何受版权保护的素材
example: The label sued them for infringing on the song.
example_cn: 厂牌起诉他们侵犯了歌曲版权。
note: infringe on＝侵犯。名词 infringement；形容词 infringing。

meaning_en: to produce the results or work expected of you
quote: if you want to live here, you've got to deliver
quote_cn: 你想住这儿就得拿出东西来。
example: He promised a launch by Friday and delivered.
example_cn: 他承诺周五上线，确实做到了。
note: 职场引申义＝兑现承诺。反义 fail to deliver。

meaning_en: a person or thing that contributes nothing
quote: I can't have dead weight at my Incubator
quote_cn: 我的孵化器里不能养闲人。
example: Two contractors were dead weight on that project.
example_cn: 那两个外包在项目里基本是闲人。
note: 职场评价他人常用；也指行李等多余负重。

meaning_en: to show signs of being good at something
quote: show some promise for fuck's sake
quote_cn: 拜托表现点潜力吧。
example: The junior analyst shows real promise.
example_cn: 那位初级分析师很有潜力。
note: 名词 a promise＝潜力。字面「做出承诺」是另一义。

meaning_en: to return something to society or a community
quote: When I sold my company, Aviato, I wanted to give back.
quote_cn: 卖掉 Aviato 后我想做点回馈。
example: Several founders give back by funding scholarships.
example_cn: 有几位创始人通过资助奖学金回馈社会。
note: 此处是慈善义，不是「退还」。名词 give-back。

meaning_en: hand the mic to the next speaker
quote: Take it away, my good friend, Kid Rock.
quote_cn: 交给我的好兄弟 Kid Rock 吧。
example: Great speech. I'll take it away from here.
example_cn: 说得好，剩下的交给我。
note: 主持人口令。也可指「拿走」具体物品。

meaning_en: stock options already earned and yours
quote: with top pay and vested stock options
quote_cn: 顶薪加已归属的股票期权
example: After four years her options were fully vested.
example_cn: 四年后她的期权完全归属了。
note: 股权激励术语：vested＝已归属可兑现。名词 vesting。

meaning_en: a meeting that achieves nothing
meaning_cn: 走过场的会；装样子的会议
quote: the marketing team is having another bike meeting
quote_cn: 市场部又在开一个走过场的会。
example: That was another bike meeting; nobody decided anything.
example_cn: 又是一个走过场的会，什么都没定。
note: 源自「骑自行车」＝原地踏步。职场吐槽高频。

meaning_en: a workplace where everyone is under the same controlling boss
quote: inside the Gavin Belson cult compound
quote_cn: 在 Gavin Belson 那个邪教式大本营里。
example: Two startups quit to escape the cult-compound environment.
example_cn: 两家初创公司为了逃离那种邪教环境离职了。
note: 字面邪教总部；讽刺公司内部同质化、被老板控制。

meaning_en: a business student who can code
quote: Brogrammers.
quote_cn: 那帮「布rogrammer」。
example: They hired a brogrammer to build the internal tool.
example_cn: 他们招了个会写代码的商科生来做内部工具。
note: 由 bro（兄弟）+ programmer 拼合；也作 code bro。

meaning_en: someone who attacks established conventions
quote: An iconoclast.
quote_cn: 一个反传统的怪人。
example: Every great product team needs one iconoclast.
example_cn: 每个优秀的产品团队都需要一个反传统的怪才。
note: 形容词 iconoclastic。词根指「破坏偶像的人」。

meaning_en: more people reviewing it
quote: it's always good to have more eyes on it
quote_cn: 多让人看看总是好的。
example: Let's get more eyes on this contract before signing.
example_cn: 签之前多找几个人看看这份合同。
note: 职场常用；get eyes on＝找…评审。

meaning_en: to produce large quantities mechanically
quote: a system that happily churns out unemployed debtors
quote_cn: 一个源源不断产出失业负债者的系统
example: The factory churns out two thousand units a day.
example_cn: 这家厂每天产出两千台。
note: 含贬义，暗示机械、低质。名词 churn＝流失率（客流失）。

meaning_en: questionable worth
quote: provides dubious value
quote_cn: 提供的价值可疑。
example: That certification turned out to be of dubious value.
example_cn: 那个证书后来证明并没什么价值。
note: 形容词 dubious＝可疑的、可疑的功用。名词 dubiety。

meaning_en: a bogus remedy or unsupported claim
meaning_cn: 江湖偏方；没有依据的说法
quote: The true value of snake-oil is intangible as well.
quote_cn: 江湖偏方的真正价值同样是 intangible。
example: That growth hack is just snake oil with a good deck.
example_cn: 那个增长方法就是套了漂亮壳的江湖偏方。
note: snake-oil merchant＝骗子。snake oil＝真有疗效的蛇油，现多贬义。

meaning_en: get ready, time is short
meaning_cn: 扣好安全带；准备好（时间不多）
quote: You have until I fasten the seat-belt in my car.
quote_cn: 你还有时间，直到我扣上安全带。
example: The clock is ticking — fasten your seat-belt.
example_cn: 时间不多了，赶紧准备。
note: 职场倒计时的幽默说法；也真指系安全带。

meaning_en: owned by a company and legally protected
quote: Pied Piper is a proprietary site
quote_cn: Pied Piper 是个专有网站
example: Their proprietary algorithm is the whole moat.
example_cn: 他们的专有算法就是全部护城河。
note: 反义 open-source。名词 proprietary tech＝专有技术。

meaning_en: losing no data in compression
quote: the compression is totally lossless
quote_cn: 这个压缩是完全无损的。
example: FLAC is a lossless format; MP3 is not.
example_cn: FLAC 是无损格式，MP3 不是。
note: 反义 lossy（有损的），后者是日常常用词。

meaning_en: aimed at business customers rather than end users
quote: make it business facing and use it for enterprise
quote_cn: 把它改成 B 端，给企业用。
example: Consumer apps are harder to monetise than business-facing tools.
example_cn: 消费级应用比 B 端工具更难变现。
note: 对比 consumer facing＝面向终端用户。写正式商业计划书常用。

meaning_en: a stock repeated point, often criticised
quote: The usual riffs on twitter and instagram.
quote_cn: 推特和 insta 上那些老生常调。
example: His set was forty minutes of riffs he'd been doing for years.
example_cn: 他的整场演出四十分钟都是他演了好几年的老段子。
note: 原指音乐重复段落；引申为套路化的观点。动词 riff on＝就…发挥。

meaning_en: to tease or joke with someone
quote: we're just messing with you
quote_cn: 我们就是逗你玩。
example: Don't mess with him before the presentation.
example_cn: 汇报之前别逗他。
note: 另有一义「招惹／收拾（某人）」，看语境。

meaning_en: to not attend or leave college
quote: people willing to skip or drop out of college
quote_cn: 愿意退学或不上大学的人
example: He skipped college and went straight into consulting.
example_cn: 他退学后直接去做了咨询。
note: drop out=中途退学；skip=根本没去。两者常混用。

meaning_en: total value of assets minus debts
quote: there's 40 billion dollars of net worth, walking around this party
quote_cn: 这个派会上游荡着四百亿的净资产。
example: His net worth doubled after the IPO.
example_cn: 上市后他的净资产翻了一番。
note: 个人身家口径是资产减负债，跟「身家/估值」不同。

meaning_en: an instruction marking the correct orientation
quote: this side up
quote_cn: 此面向上。
example: Mark the parcel this side up and label it fragile.
example_cn: 包裹上标「此面向上」，再贴易碎标签。
note: 物流标签语；此处在剧里被拿来调侃纹身的位置。
